summary: Standard Nuclear, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) announcing a binding fuel supply agreement with Antares Nuclear, Inc. Under the agreement, Standard Nuclear will deliver a minimum of one metric ton of uranium (MTU) and up to eight MTUs of TRISO fuel to Antares through 2035, intended for microreactors in defense and space applications. No financial terms, pricing, or equity stakes were disclosed. The filing is routine disclosure of a commercial contract, not a special situation. The agreement supports ongoing partnership and domestic supply chain for advanced nuclear reactors. No strategic, capital, or ownership changes occurred; thus this does not meet special-situation criteria.
